build_imagenet_subset_builder: build a class balanced subset of ImageNet 2012 dataset with 1pct or 10pct training configurations
create_dataset_info: create dataset info with image, class label, and file name features for the ImageNet subset
generate_train_split: generate a training split from ImageNet tar archive filtered by a class-balanced subset file
generate_validation_split: generate a validation split from ImageNet validation tar archive with precomputed labels
review_builder_class: review the Builder class that extends imagenet2012 dataset builder for subset generation
